rates.name: Edmonton to Kamloops
conditions: Light crude petroleum only in this calculator.
Uncommitted service, tank-metered receipt at Edmonton. No direct-inject credit.
Published transport subtotal. Additional applicable charges are excluded.
All volumes are assumed accepted and delivered. Capacity, nominations and apportionment are not modeled.
Schedule effective May 1, 2026. No end date appears in this schedule. Do not assume this rate applies to another shipment date without checking subsequent filings.
The September 2026 settlement takes effect January 1, 2027. Order TO-005-2026 addresses finalization of interim-period tolls; this calculator does not import the new settlement rate framework.

borderTariff.explanation: Canadian governments do not impose a tariff simply because goods or services cross an internal provincial or territorial border. Carrier tolls are transportation charges.

otherCharges.explanation: Taxes, permits and fees depend on the actual transaction, commodity, service and jurisdictions. No complete government-charge schedule has been sourced for these shipments. Unknown is not zero.

calculation.basis: volume_m3 multiplied by the published total toll
calculation.quantityMeaning: Delivered shipment volume, assumed accepted for uncommitted service.
calculation.rounding: Keep the published four-decimal rate. Round currency after multiplying.
calculation.componentsPolicy: The fixed and variable components explain the total. Do not add them again to the total. Included details are not additional receipt lines.
notModeled: Availability or booking of transportation service
